Definition
[Quotient CW structure]

↗ def:cw-pair

\group CW Complexes

For a CW pair $(X,A)$, $X/A$ has the cells of $X-A$ together with one new 0-cell. The attaching map of a remaining cell is the composite of its original attaching map with $X^{n-1}\to X^{n-1}/A^{n-1}$.
